scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONT,BFF,BACK -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace @nexus/front" "npm run dev --workspace @nexus/bff" "npm run dev --workspace @nexus/back"
scripts.dev:front: npm run build --workspace @nexus/common && npm run dev --workspace @nexus/front
scripts.dev:back: npm run build --workspace @nexus/common && npm run dev --workspace @nexus/back
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nexus/common && npm run build --workspace @nexus/back && npm run build --workspace @nexus/bff && npm run build --workspace @nexus/front
